steps.title: Retry policy struct
steps.note: RetryPolicy defines the knobs: enabled, max_retries, retryable statuses and errors, base and max delay, and whether the fallback chain is enabled.

steps.title: Load organization policy
steps.note: load_policy reads the organization's fallback_retry_policies row from SQLite, returning the default policy when no row exists.

steps.title: Decide whether to retry
steps.note: should_retry checks that the policy is enabled, the attempt is within max_retries, the status is retryable, and either the error wildcard matches or the error type is in the allowlist.

steps.title: Compute backoff delay
steps.note: next_backoff_ms uses exponential backoff capped at max_delay_ms and applies full jitter so retries do not thunder against the upstream.

steps.title: Select primary or fallback model
steps.note: select_fallback returns the primary model on attempt 1 and walks the fallback chain on subsequent attempts. If the chain is disabled, it always returns the primary.
